# Henry Patrick Beauty And Hair Braiding Salon

> Hair braiding salon based in Round Rock, Texas. Knotless and boho braids, twists, cornrows, starter locs and kids' styles in Round Rock. Neat, gentle, fast and on time, from a braider clients have trusted for years.

- Phone: (512) 822-5941

- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Pflugerville, Hutto, Georgetown, Austin, Cedar Park
- Google rating: 4.9 from 141 reviews

## Services
- Knotless & box braids: Small to large knotless and box braids with clean, even parts, in natural black or auburn, copper and honey tones. Clients say they're never too tight.
- Boho braids: Knotless braids with loose curls through the length, from shoulder to waist length, often done in about three hours.
- Twists: Two-strand, micro and Senegalese twists, smooth and even from root to end, in natural black, color blends or silver.
- Stitch braids & cornrows: Crisp stitch braids, straight-back cornrows and freestyle designs, for women, men and kids.
- Starter locs: Starter locs with neat, square parts to begin your loc journey right.
- Kids' braids: Box braids, cornrows and beaded styles for kids. Moms bring their daughters, and some girls have been coming to Henry for years.

## About
Henry Patrick Beauty And Hair Braiding Salon is Henry's shop in Suite 39 at 3000 Joe DiMaggio Blvd, Round Rock. He recently moved into a new space that clients describe as chic and upscale, a place where you can relax and feel welcome. Many of his clients have been with him for years. One says he has been doing her hair since 2007; another has been coming for more than seven years. Moms bring their daughters, and everyone mentions the same things: flawless, neat work, braids that are never too tight, real respect for your time, and styles done fast enough that you don't lose the whole day. Braids are the heart of it, but clients also mention crochet styles, weaves, blowouts and bridal hair. Tell Henry the look and the occasion, and he'll help you choose what suits you.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 8 PM. Closed Sunday. Holiday hours can change, so call (512) 822-5941 if you're not sure.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: Suite 39 at 3000 Joe DiMaggio Blvd, Round Rock, TX 78665. It's an easy drive from Pflugerville, Hutto, Georgetown, Cedar Park and north Austin.
- Q: What styles do you do?
  A: Knotless and box braids, boho braids, two-strand, micro and Senegalese twists, stitch braids and cornrows, starter locs and kids' styles. Clients also mention crochet, weaves, blowouts and bridal hair.
- Q: Will my braids be too tight?
  A: Clients say no. One tender-headed client says Henry braids and twists "not tight but just right", and another says her knotless braids left her with zero pain and itching.
- Q: How long do boho braids take?
  A: It depends on size and length. One client says her daughter's waist-length boho braids are usually done in three hours or less. Call with the style you want for a time estimate.
- Q: Do you braid kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Many clients bring their daughters, and some have been braided here for years.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Call (512) 822-5941 or send a booking request on this site with the style, size and length you want. A photo of the look helps.
